title: Last-admin protection: admin minimum_participants_constraint = 1 needs an admin handover before leave
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.56 item 5 keeps the default admin role's minimum_participants_constraint at 0. room-policy-04 Appendix A.1 group_admin uses 1, so a room never loses its last admin. That needs the agent to hand admin to another participant (a canChangeUserRole Commit, 2->3) before the sole admin leaves, and to refuse or reorder a leave that the hub would refuse; otherwise the refused leave proposals block the room. Mark: want this, and if so is automatic handover (to whom?) or an explicit role-change operation in the JMAP surface the way?
